description: Close a Photoshop document — the active one by default, or a specific one by name or id. Destructive if save=false and the document has unsaved changes. If two open documents share the requested name the call fails rather than guessing. Returns the closed document name plus a fresh context block (which document, if any, is active afterwards).

id.description: Target an open document by its Photoshop document id. Unambiguous — prefer this when names collide.

name.description: Target an open document by its exact Photoshop name, INCLUDING the extension as shown in the tab (e.g. 'portrait.jpg', not 'portrait'). If two open documents share a name the call fails rather than guessing — target by id instead.

save.description: Whether to save changes before closing

name: ps_close_document
